biography.plain_text: John Eddie Williams is an American trial lawyer and founding partner of Houston firm Williams Hart & Boundas. A Baylor law graduate who finished first in his class, he built a national practice in mass torts and personal injury. He was among the lawyers representing Texas in its landmark tobacco-industry settlement.

long_biography.plain_text:
Trial lawyer John Eddie Williams grew up in a family of union longshoremen. His mother encouraged him to enter the law, repeating her ambition when the family attended longshoremen's conferences on summer trips to Miami. Although he considered a corporate career, he chose to represent people whose legal rights might otherwise go undefended.

His charitable giving has involved meeting the people it helps. Williams and his wife, Sheridan, visited the Goodfellows toy distribution centre with their daughters, speaking with recipients and volunteers. The couple's repeated donations paid for Christmas gifts for Houston children, and they later presented an annual contribution at a recipient family's home.
